description_for_human: Search and book last-minute deals on events, wellness, beauty, and hospitality within 72 hours.
description_for_model: Search real-time last-minute deals and book them. Use searchSlots to find available deals by category/city/price, getSlotQuote to confirm availability, then bookSlot to initiate checkout. Card is only charged after booking is confirmed — never for failed bookings. Use executeIntent for autonomous one-shot booking.
